title: Restaurant Talk
content: Here are fourteen universal standard lines used verbatim by table servers in the USA.1. Table for four? (...and until recently: “Smoking or non?”)2. Can I start you off with something to drink?3. Our specials today are...”4. Can I take your order?5. How would you like that?6. Your order will be right out.7. Fresh ground pepper? (Holding grinder over salad) Tell me when.8. How's everything?9. Are you still working on that?10. Can I take that out of your way?11. Room for dessert?12. Warm up on your coffee?13. Are you ready for your check?14. I’ll take that when you’re ready.
